## Overall Response Rate (ORR) {#sec-orr}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
orr_data |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior") |>
  ggplot() +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(xdist = sample_target_orr, y = trial, color = fit_type),
                     .width = c(0.5, 0.9)) +
  scale_color_discrete("", type = AZ_palette, label = str_to_title) +
  scale_x_continuous("Overall Response Rate (ORR)", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(y = "") +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Sample-based ORR (posterior).](clinical-endpoints_files/figure-html/fig-orr-sample-1.png){#fig-orr-sample width=576}
:::
:::


### Prior vs Posterior


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
orr_data |>
  filter(grepl("lilly_cxcr4", trial)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = filter(obs_orr, grepl("lilly_cxcr4", trial)),
             aes(x = obs_orr, y = trial),
             shape = 4, size = 4, stroke = 1.5, color = "grey30") +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(xdist = sample_target_orr, y = trial, color = fit_type),
                     .width = c(0.5, 0.9), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_discrete("", type = AZ_palette, label = str_to_title) +
  scale_x_continuous("Overall Response Rate (ORR)", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(y = "", caption = "× = observed ORR (confirmed objective response before PFS, SLD-derived RECIST)") +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Prior vs posterior ORR comparison.](clinical-endpoints_files/figure-html/fig-orr-prior-post-1.png){#fig-orr-prior-post width=576}
:::
:::


:::

## Median PFS {#sec-median-pfs}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pfs_quant |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior", quantile == 0.5) |>
  ggplot() +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(xdist = sample_pfs_quant, y = trial, color = fit_type),
                     .width = c(0.5, 0.9)) +
  scale_x_continuous("Median PFS [Months]",
                     breaks = months_to_weeks(seq(0, 30, 3)),
                     label  = label_weeks_to_months) +
  scale_color_discrete("", type = AZ_palette, label = str_to_title) +
  labs(y = "") +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Sample-based median PFS (posterior). Weeks converted to months for display.](clinical-endpoints_files/figure-html/fig-median-pfs-sample-1.png){#fig-median-pfs-sample width=576}
:::
:::


### Prior vs Posterior


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pfs_quant |>
  filter(quantile == 0.5, grepl("lilly_cxcr4", trial)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 27, linetype = "Observed median PFS\n(both arms ≈ 6.2 months)"),
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = "dashed") +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(xdist = sample_pfs_quant, y = trial, color = fit_type),
                     .width = c(0.5, 0.9), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous("Median PFS [Months]",
                     breaks = months_to_weeks(seq(0, 30, 3)),
                     label  = label_weeks_to_months) +
  scale_color_discrete("", type = AZ_palette, label = str_to_title) +
  labs(y = "") +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Prior vs posterior median PFS comparison.](clinical-endpoints_files/figure-html/fig-median-pfs-prior-post-1.png){#fig-median-pfs-prior-post width=576}
:::
:::

## PFS at Fixed Timepoints {#sec-pfs-n}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pfs_n_data |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior") |>
  ggplot() +
  stat_pointinterval(
    aes(ydist = sample_pfs_n, x = timepoint, color = fit_type,
        group = interaction(fit_type, timepoint)),
    position = "dodge", .width = c(0.5, 0.8)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous("Timepoint [Months]", breaks = pfs_timepoints$timepoint) +
  scale_y_continuous("PFS Probability", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_discrete("", type = AZ_palette, label = str_to_title) +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![PFS probability at fixed timepoints (posterior, sample-based).](clinical-endpoints_files/figure-html/fig-pfs-n-1.png){#fig-pfs-n width=576}
:::
:::
